title: Text: DET Steve Liddle ↔ Anthony Fenech

content.text: Did you know Rick Knapp well? Any thoughts?
An ATL guy asked me about him
I know him extremely well. When we lost him as a Coordinator with the Twins, we never recovered. Rick Anderson and Gardy will tell you the very same thing.  I hope Atlanta gets him

He is well thought of in the industry.  I don’t think he was ready for the situation in Detroit at the time he got that job. There were a few underlying issues that kept him from him being at his best.
Just actually walked in the door from girls basketball practice. Go Team!

That’s correct. One sport to the next. My motto during the off-season is: Adjust, Improvise, and Adapt. When you decide to make the move to DC,  a family will follow; then you will join me in the club of parenting. Your Time becomes Their Time. Like the TV character Monk says, “It’s a Blessing and a Curse”.
I just got back from the weekend in DC today; keep your fingers crossed, please.
